producer_report.summary:
Root cause: the planner brief gave no computed list of existing callers or exits for the functions in the deliverable files, only prose rules, so plans skipped adjacent paths such as `[parallel] max_concurrency` into landing. Fixed in the planner's inputs, as information and not a refusal. Athena now computes callers from the base commit and shows them in the brief; the brief also carries a new exit-table rule.

- crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs: Athena::deliverable_facts replaces the inline loop. For an existing .rs deliverable it reads the base commit's Rust files (one ls_tree, cat_blobs in chunks of 200) and parses each with syn. Per function outside test code it lists call sites in other files (production before test, 4 shown, the rest counted) and counts same-file calls. Test code is marked per item, strings and comments are not calls, macro arguments are searched, and files that do not parse are reported.
- crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs: DeliverableFact gains callers: Option<CallerList> (with CallerList, FunctionCallers and CallSite). planner_brief renders it as a labelled, approximate, capped starting list (30 names per line), and a deliverable with no callers says so. EXITS_RULE is added to the Report in both rounds.
- crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs: is_cfg_test and is_test_fn are pub(crate) so the scan shares the one definition of test code.
- Tests in briefs.rs, planning.rs and run/tests.rs; a CHANGELOG.md entry.

No refusal rule is added (admission.rs and reading checks untouched, 0% newly refused). Limits: name search is approximate; scan cost and effect on round-cap stops are not measured.

Checked in the diff of CHANGELOG.md and the doc comment on the new code in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs.

The doc comments on CallSite, DeliverableFact.callers and EXITS_RULE in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs state it too, citing jobs 20261030-013555-f5qm, 20261031-030119-tw3v, 20261103-075205-wbtm and 20261115-202532-6mng, and say it is information, not a refusal. criteria_check.criterion: DeliverableFact in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs gains a callers field. A unit test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs builds a planner brief and asserts that each caller (file:line) appears in the deliverables section. Run: cargo test -p athena-context.
criteria_check.evidence: DeliverableFact has `callers: Option<CallerList>`. The test a_planner_brief_lists_the_callers_of_each_deliverable in briefs.rs asserts crates/b/src/y.rs:20, crates/c/src/z.rs:7, crates/d/src/w.rs:3 and 'crates/b/tests/it.rs:9 (test)' appear between the Deliverables heading and the next heading and not in the Report; the_callers_lines_are_capped_and_the_other_cases_are_labelled covers the caps and the unparsed cases. Ran cargo test -q -p athena-context: 165 passed.

criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs or run/tests.rs computes callers from a fixture snapshot where a function in a deliverable file has callers in two other files. It asserts both are listed, and that a deliverable with no callers is shown as such, not omitted. It fails without the change. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: deliverable_callers_lists_both_callers_and_shows_a_deliverable_with_none in run/tests.rs builds a real git fixture and calls Athena::deliverable_facts. It asserts land_job has sites a.rs:2, b.rs:3 and tests/it.rs:1 (test) in order, and that other.rs (lonely) and unused_helper are listed with zero callers. deliverable_callers_reach_the_planner_prompt asserts the first planner prompt contains crates/x/src/a.rs:2, crates/x/src/b.rs:3 and 'No callers found: `quiet_one` (line 1), `quiet_two` (line 2)'. Both ran with: cargo test -p athena-core --lib deliverable_callers (2 passed), and the full cargo test -q -p athena-core passed. Without the change the tests do not compile because deliverable_facts and the callers field do not exist.

criteria_check.criterion: A new exits rule const in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs is added to the planner Report. It requires a plan that changes a stage or core flow to tabulate every exit (success, fail, error, hold, interrupt) with the file:line that handles it. A test in briefs.rs asserts that wording appears exactly once, in a first-round brief and in a revision brief.
criteria_check.evidence: EXITS_RULE is a pub(super) const appended after CODE_CLAIMS_RULE in the Report format string. The test the_planner_brief_requires_an_exit_table_once_in_both_rounds asserts report.matches(EXITS_RULE).count() == 1 for planner_inputs(None) and for a PlanRevision input, and that the rule has no newline and holds success, fail, error, hold, interrupt, file:line, stage and core flow. It passes under cargo test -p athena-context.

open_issues: crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs is outside the expected deliverables; it changes only two function visibilities (pub(crate)) so the caller scan shares the one definition of test code. The plan listed it and admission treats it as a Minor finding.
Time and memory of the scan per planner call were not measured; the changelog says so.
Whether a model planner follows the exit table, and the effect on round-cap stops, are not measured.
The replay of past accepted readings was not run by me; no reading check or refusal rule changed.
mistakes: The first scan_source test expected a test call on line 12 when the fixture text put it on line 11; fixed before reporting.
A test helper had a needless explicit lifetime that clippy rejected; fixed.
A first draft had an unused SITES_SHOWN const in athena-context; removed before building, since the cap for sites lives in athena-core.
learnings: The Cargo.lock resolves both syn 2.0.119 and syn 3.0.7 (3.0.7 for build-script crates); athena-core uses syn 2 through the workspace entry, and the syn 2 visit API matched.
planning.rs had no test module for planning logic beyond planning_grant_tests; the git-fixture tests live in run/tests.rs produce_and_verify_order_tests.
The reading checks accepted a fake reading whose deliverable is an existing crates/x/src/core.rs while the criterion names README.md, so the wiring test needed no fixture change.

disk::tests::dropping_the_build_folder_removes_the_jobs_target_and_the_holder_file_before_the_slot_is_free failed once in a parallel run and passed alone and in the full rerun; it is unrelated to this change.
